message.text:
Re: Q3 Trial Per the request for the finance distribution list, here is the summary for the Q3 Trial:

The Q3 Trial has achieved preliminary enrollment of 423 participants with an adverse event rate of 18%. Please note that as indicated by the board secretary, these figures are preliminary and should only be quoted as such until the board meeting confirms the final figures. The preliminary enrollment number and adverse event rate reflect the current status of the trial data as of late October 2026.

Best regards,
Jamie Okafor
